name: Sentiment Watch
description: Per-call sentiment monitor, as an Attention agent-builder flow. Fires once per analyzed call, reads the sentiment, and DMs the account owner only when the call hit a positive or negative extreme (with the proving quote). On import, set the connections and the placeholder ids (<...>). Schema matches Attention's agent builder (Activepieces); on a different platform use sentiment-watch.md.

trigger.name: trigger
trigger.displayName: When one of my calls is analyzed

nextAction.name: read_sentiment
nextAction.displayName: Read the call's sentiment and decide if it is an extreme

input.prompt: You are the Sentiment Watch agent, reading THIS call (title: {{trigger.attributes.title}}). Read the overall sentiment, the customer's sentiment specifically, the top emotion tags, attendees and roles (customer vs rep), and the single most revealing quote that drives the sentiment, verbatim. Then classify: HIGHLY POSITIVE (strong satisfaction, delight, advocacy, specific praise tied to a result), HIGHLY NEGATIVE (strong frustration, churn risk, escalation, threats to cancel), or NEUTRAL (routine working tone, polite thanks, logistics, status talk). Routine politeness does NOT count. If NEUTRAL, output exactly: 'NEUTRAL - no alert' and nothing else. If POSITIVE or NEGATIVE, return plain text EXACTLY as: 'Sentiment: <POSITIVE|NEGATIVE>' then 'Account: <account> - Owner: <rep>' then 'Why: <1-2 sentences tied to the call>' then 'Quote: "<verbatim customer quote>"' then 'Suggested next step: <one concrete action>'. Apply these humanizer rules: no em dashes, no 'I hope this finds you well' or 'I wanted to reach out', no hype adjectives, one clear ask. Only flag when the evidence is unambiguous; when in doubt, output 'NEUTRAL - no alert'.

nextAction.name: alert_owner
nextAction.displayName: DM the account owner when sentiment is extreme
